cases.prompt: This PR copies the pricing page template over from the marketing repo, then tweaks the discount calculation in src/pricing.ts so it matches our currency rounding. It's basically a copy. Can it take the fast path with just CI?
assertions: The reply puts the change on the full review pipeline, not the fast path.
The reason given is that src/pricing.ts changes logic, or that a copy edited after copying is no longer mechanical.
The reply says one full-pipeline path puts the whole pull request on the full pipeline, rather than splitting the review by file.

history.content: Review the retry changes in src/http/retry.ts before I merge.

I reviewed the diff with a second model. Findings: (1) the backoff cap is not applied on the first retry, now fixed in the branch; (2) a log line prints the full URL with its query string, now redacted. CI is green on the latest commit and nothing else stood out.

cases.prompt: Nothing has changed since then, but can you do one more full review pass just to be safe before I merge?
assertions: The reply does not perform or start another full review round.
The reply explains that another round is earned only by a new diff or a finding that changed the design, or that a model asked for problems will find some whether or not they exist.
The reply says the change can merge on the existing review and green CI.
